name: Application Layer
description: The two deployable Python processes (FastAPI API and the background worker) — app bootstrap, health-check routing, and pydantic-settings configuration that expose and configure the market-scanning service.

name: Market Data Provider Layer
description: The hexagonal port/adapter boundary for external market data — the abstract MarketDataProvider port and the concrete Polygon.io adapter that translates vendor JSON into canonical shapes, decoupling the rest of the system from any single data vendor.

name: Schema / DTO Layer
description: Canonical, provider-agnostic pydantic data shapes (InstrumentDTO, OHLCVBar, Quote) that form the common contract between the market data provider adapters and downstream consumers.

name: Data Layer
description: Persistence for the market-scanning universe: SQLAlchemy ORM models, the shared async DB session factory, and the Alembic migration history (including the TimescaleDB-backed instruments and profiles tables) that define and evolve the schema.

name: Testing Layer
description: Automated pytest coverage for the Polygon adapter and API health check, their JSON response fixtures, and the manual smoke-test script used to exercise the Polygon adapter against the live API.

name: Infrastructure & Configuration
description: Root-level project setup: local TimescaleDB/Redis containers (docker-compose), environment variable and Alembic templates, Python dependency manifest and interpreter pin, and the top-level README onboarding guide.

name: CI/CD Pipeline
description: The GitHub Actions backend-ci workflow and its ordered job steps (dependency sync, lint, migration apply, test run) that gate every pull request against a TimescaleDB service container.
